scope: GRCh37 prospective locus variants only; source allele labels preserved
SNP: If nonpalindromic and exactly one physical strand orientation matches the verified reference nucleotide, orient nucleotide labels accordingly. Complement alone preserves beta sign. REF/ALT are then determined by the reference base, not by effect sign.
palindromic: Unresolved without independent strand/frequency evidence satisfying preflight; do not use Catalog assumed-forward code alone.
indel_complex: Requires independent REF/ALT identity and assembly-aware left-normalization. Sequence-prefix compatibility alone cannot distinguish anchored insertion from deletion in repeats. Defer when no independent identity supplied.
risk_direction: Only verified normalized contrast, passing signed-statistic test, nonambiguous OR rounding interval, and no conflicting duplicate. Positive logOR => normalized effect allele; negative => normalized other allele. No risk labels assigned from REF/ALT.
